results.title: Afenyo-Markin accuses Mahama of sidelining Big Six in new currency design
results.content: Minority Leader Alexander Afenyo-Markin has taken aim at the Mahama administration over the exclusion of five members of the Big Six from Ghana’s newly unveiled banknotes, arguing that the decision overlooks their historic role in the country’s independence struggle.

results.title: Advertisers Association rejects political claims over crackdown on illegal billboards
results.content: The Advertising Association of Ghana (AAG) has rejected suggestions that the ongoing demolition of unauthorised billboards and advertising structures is politically motivated, saying the exercise is intended to protect the public interest and improve urban spaces.

results.title: Assemblies to face sanctions over illegal billboards – Deputy Minister
results.content: The Deputy Minister for Local Government, Chieftaincy and Religious Affairs, Rita Naa Odoley Sowah, has warned Metropolitan, Municipal and District Chief Executives (MMDCEs) that they will be held responsible for unauthorised billboards and advertising structures erected within their jurisdictions.

results.title: Every family should have a Family Pharmacist: The future of personalised pharmaceutical care in Ghana
results.content: One such approach is introducing and promoting Family Pharmacist services, so every family can access a designated pharmacist who understands the family's pharmaceutical and medication-related needs.

results.title: Mahama to commission 30,000-tonne cashew processing factory in Techiman
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama is expected to commission the Nadkansco Cashew Processing Factory in Techiman on Monday, November 16, in a move aimed at strengthening local agro-processing, creating jobs and increasing Ghana’s export earnings.

results.title: Ghana targets more visa waiver deals by end of 2027 – Ablakwa
results.content: Ghana is pursuing additional visa waiver agreements with countries across the world, with the government expecting to conclude more deals before the end of 2027, Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa has said.

results.title: Ajumako 24-hour economy market 9% complete; traders raise concerns over project location
results.content: The construction of a 24-hour economy market in the Ajumako-Enyan-Essiam District in the Central Region, which commenced in April this year, is progressing steadily, with nine per cent of the work completed.

results.title: Ghana records GHS209.7m in cybersecurity losses in nine months
results.content: Ghana recorded more than GHS209.7 million in financial losses from 4,938 cybersecurity incidents between January and September 2026.

results.title: Ablakwa highlights Mahama’s Volta projects
results.content: Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Member of Parliament (MP) for North Tongu, has described the Volivo bridge construction and the 12,000-capacity FIFA-standard stadium in the Volta region as a big push for the development of the region.

results.title: Joyce Bawah Mogtari hails NDC’s democratic process, expresses confidence in party’s future
results.content: Senior Aide and Advisor to President John Mahama, Joyce Bawah Mogtari, has expressed renewed confidence in the National Democratic Congress (NDC) 's future following the successful organisation of the party’s constituency and regional elections.

results.title: Moroccan Sahara: France reiterates ‘unwavering’ position in support of Morocco’s sovereignty and of autonomy
results.content: France reiterated on Friday its "unwavering" position that "the present and future of Western Sahara fall within the framework of Moroccan sovereignty," according to a statement from the spokesperson for the French Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs.

results.title: Ghana receives up to 62 tonnes of mercury annually through illicit channels
results.content: Ghana receives between 42.5 and 62 tonnes of mercury annually through illicit channels for use in artisanal and small-scale gold mining, stakeholders have disclosed.

results.title: Ghana’s difficult reforms are bearing fruit – IMF
results.content: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) says Ghana is reaping the benefits of difficult policy reforms, with stronger-than-expected growth, single-digit inflation and an improved fiscal position.

results.title: US officials say violence against Christians in Nigeria remains a key concern
results.content: Violence against Nigerian Christians remains a key concern, the US State Department said, a year after the Trump administration accused Nigeria of violating religious freedoms and designated ​it as a "country of particular concern" (CPC).

results.title: Oil prices fall on expectations of coming supply surplus
results.content: Oil prices fell on Monday on expectations of a supply surplus as shipments from the Middle East through the Strait of Hormuz have nearly returned to pre-war levels and the US took steps to support the movement of fuel cargoes between domestic ports.

results.title: Nearly 1,500 migrants arrive in Canary Islands in one day
results.content: Almost 1,500 migrants arrived in Spain's Canary Islands on Saturday, the highest number in a single day since 2020, the EFE ​news agency reported on Sunday, citing the maritime rescue service.

results.title: Klopp says FIFA worse under Infantino than Blatter
results.content: FIFA president Gianni Infantino should be replaced, as he has made world football's governing body worse than it was under disgraced former chief Sepp Blatter, Germany coach Jürgen Klopp said on Sunday.

results.title: Salah breaks Egypt scoring record as Tunisia lose to Libya
results.content: Tunisia’s dismal ​run continued with a 2-0 home defeat by Libya in an Africa Cup of Nations qualifier on ‌Friday, while Mohamed Salah became Egypt’s record scorer in their 5-0 rout of Malawi.

results.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia’s main airport due to altitude
results.content: Nigeria's government has cautioned its citizens, especially those with medical conditions, against travelling via Ethiopia's main airport because of its altitude.

results.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia’s ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
results.content: Alice Huang, a suspected China spy who has been linked to Nvidia's former boss Jensen Huang, left her executive role at Megaspeed in August last year, the company says.

results.title: Sabalenka apologises and says viral comment ‘not directed at Svitolina’
results.content: Aryna Sabalenka has apologised and denied claims that she insulted opponent Elina Svitolina after a viral clip showed her swearing during her WTA Finals defeat by the Ukrainian.

results.title: Zverev ‘felt a lot of joy’ in first win as world number one
results.content: Alexander Zverev said he felt "a lot of joy" after sweeping aside Rafael Jodar to claim his first victory as world number one in the opening match of the ATP Finals.

results.title: Belgium come back to beat Italy to quarters spot
results.content: Belgium qualified for the Nations League quarter-finals at the expense of Italy after coming from behind to beat the Azzurri.

results.title: Kroupi scores as France beat Turkey to take top spot
results.content: Bournemouth forward Eli Junior Kroupi scored his first goal for France as they beat Turkey to seal a place in the Nations League quarter-finals.

results.title: Tenerife return to action after death of De Miguel
results.content: Tenerife played their first game since the death of striker Jesus de Miguel on an emotional day at the Heliodoro Rodriguez Lopez stadium.

results.title: United States thrash Haiti in Pochettino’s penultimate match
results.content: Mauricio Pochettino guided the United States to a thumping 6-0 win over Haiti in his penultimate game in charge.

results.title: Portugal humbled in first game since Ronaldo retirement
results.content: Portugal suffered a heavy loss in their first game since Cristiano Ronaldo announced his international retirement as former Manchester United striker Rasmus Hojlund scored twice to help Denmark gain a superb victory.

results.title: Ben White has ‘exciting future’ despite boos – Declan Rice
results.content: Declan Rice has defended Arsenal teammate Ben White after the defender was booed at Wembley during England's 2-1 win over Croatia on Thursday.

results.title: Ancelotti and captain Raphinha were sent off as Japan beat Brazil
results.content: Manager Carlo Ancelotti and captain Raphinha were sent off as Brazil were beaten by a stoppage-time winner in a friendly against Japan in Singapore.

results.title: England hold on to stun world champions Spain in thriller
results.content: England produced a superb display – their finest under head coach Thomas Tuchel – and survived a late siege to earn a landmark victory against World Cup holders Spain in Madrid.
